title: Find Your Bottleneck
calendarDescription: A free hands-along hour with Kelly at Wise Women Use AI. Find the part of your business that still relies on you too heavily, and decide what to do about it.

thankYou.whatWeDoingSub: One hour. We find the part of your business that still runs through you, and you leave having decided what to do about it.

cards.title: Your bottleneck, named
cards.body: Whether the business waits on what you remember, on work that restarts from scratch every time, or on you having the energy to push it. You'll know which one is yours.

cards.title: A map of your recurring week
cards.body: Everything that comes round again, out of your head and onto one page where you can actually look at it. Most people have never seen it written down.

cards.title: Every item classified
cards.body: Keep it human, let AI assist it, systemise it, automate it, delegate it, or delete it. We go through your list together and you decide, item by item.

cards.title: One priority system chosen
cards.body: The single thing worth building first, and a decision about what you're changing in the next thirty days. A real start, not a finished business.

thankYou.beforeSub: Two small things, and neither of them takes long.

steps.title: Take the Business Bottleneck Audit first
steps.body: About five minutes, and it tells you which of the three bottlenecks you're carrying. You can take it here. Bring your result with you and we'll work from it on the day. Haven't done it? Come anyway, we'll sort it in the room.

steps.title: Have a rough think about your week
steps.body: Not a list, just a sense of what comes round again. The things you do every week without thinking, the ones you'd notice if they stopped. Half-formed is perfect, that's the raw material.

steps.title: Come with your camera off and your tea on
steps.body: No hot seats, nothing to prepare, no homework before you arrive. Just show up.

_invitePitch_comment: Topic-specific pitch for the two WHOLE-LIST run-up invites. Rewrite every month, same as reminderPrep. It lives here and not in the template because until 27 Aug 2026 it WAS hardcoded in the template, and September's invites would have gone to every subscriber describing August's content workshop. Leave it out and the generator falls back to a bare one-liner built from the topic.
invitePitch:
It's about the part of your business that still runs through you.

You've done the work. You've tried Claude or ChatGPT, you've got a couple of automations running, and individual tasks are faster than they were. And your week looks much the same. That isn't a discipline problem and it isn't a tools problem. Automating a task doesn't take you out of it, it moves you from doing the work to supervising the work, which is still your time and still your head.

So in one hour we find the thing your business actually waits on, get your recurring week onto one page, and you decide what changes in the next thirty days.
inviteShort: It's about the part of your business that relies on you too heavily. In one hour we find it, get your recurring week onto one page, and you leave having decided what to change.
